title: Localization and elliptic motivic relations
summary: We observe that the motivic analogue of Suslin reciprocity (and similar degree-zero statements) is a formal consequence of localization (plus purity/some six functor formalism). In particular, the statement of Suslin reciprocity for smooth schemes over fields due to Kriz is a corollary of localization for higher Chow groups, over any base; we write down the framework yielding such relations with coefficients for schemes smooth over any base in $\A^1$-invariant motivic cohomology. As an application, we refine some relations between cup products of modular units to be integral in coefficients…
